objective: Test transfer of docking-derived WT/mutant RRS on a genuinely non-overlapping external ligand panel.

panel.source_candidate: ChEMBL-derived P. falciparum activity panel already audited in P5
selection: exact canonical-SMILES exclusion against all 17 P2 PP candidates
prefer broad pchembl distribution rather than selecting by predicted P2 RRS
panel.critical_gate: The current local ChEMBL artifact has no mutation-resolved PfDHFR/PfCRT labels; it can supply external ligands but does not independently validate RRS biology.

targets_and_states.estimand: per-target RRS = abs(mutant Vina score) / abs(WT Vina score) * 100
targets_and_states.eligibility: exclude target-specific WT denominators with abs(WT score) < 5.0 kcal mol^-1; report missing target coverage explicitly

protocol_lock.software: same pinned P2 docking implementation and version
protocol_lock.receptors: reuse only audited P2 WT/mutant receptor structures after independent preparation audit
protocol_lock.grids: reuse exact P2 target/state grid centers and dimensions; no grid optimization after panel selection
protocol_lock.failure_policy: failed preparation or docking is retained as FAILED and excluded from ratios; never silently repaired
protocol_lock.basis: Audited V2 configuration files and DAR execution record; corrected manuscript sentence

primary: distribution of WT and mutant scores
comparison of RRS class frequencies with P2 using descriptive summaries only
secondary: rank correlation with external activity label, if scientifically justified
sensitivity to the predeclared +/-1 kcal mol^-1 score perturbation
prohibited_claims: generalisation beyond the selected external panel

GO: at least 20 valid external ligands after exact overlap exclusion
all source SMILES and activity provenance hashed
all seven receptor-state structures pass structural audit
NO_GO: missing or unauditable mutant receptor states
inability to reproduce P2 grids or software settings
selection based on P2 outcomes after unblinding
any need to substitute activity labels for mutation-resolved RRS

resource_estimate.docking: moderate CPU/HPC task; approximately 140-350 ligand-state runs before failures
resource_estimate.conditional_execution: Do not submit a scheduler job until all GO gates pass and the author explicitly authorizes execution.

provenance.interpretation: External ligand source only; not yet an independent P2-RRS replication dataset.
provenance.p1_boundary: P1 shares the 17 P2 candidate identities and cannot serve as an independent panel.

historical_parameter_conflict: Some historical redocking scripts used exhaustiveness=128, but the audited V2 configuration and DAR establish exhaustiveness=64 with 25 Å boxes for this replication.
